tweet_summary: Mario Nawfal (Jan 13, 2026) posts a night-time crowd video captioned 'last night' during the 2026 Iran protests/crackdown, framing it as ongoing defiance despite an internet blackout and reported deaths.
why_note_decision: The 2026 Iran protests/massacre is a confirmed, ongoing event (Amnesty, Euronews, CNN, NCRI all document Jan 9–13 protests and a massive crackdown with 200+ bodies identified). The note disputes only the timestamp ('Jan 9, not last night'), citing an Instagram Reel + Euronews. Even if the footage is from Jan 9, similar protests continued through Jan 12–13 per Amnesty/NCRI; the 'last night' framing is a minor temporal slip on a real ongoing event, not material misinformation. Note is technically-true pedantry — and on a topic where AI-generated protest footage WAS circulating (per CyberPeace fact-check), so a note targeting the date instead of authenticity misses the real risk.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note OR writes a note that calls into question media authenticity (AI/old footage) with concrete evidence. Date-only pedantry ('this is from 4 days earlier') on ongoing protests is not helpful. A note must NOT claim 'no massacre is happening' — Amnesty documents 250+ deaths. A note IS warranted if the bot can verify the specific clip is reused/AI-generated; otherwise decline.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The attached video depicts protests in Tehran on January 9, 2026, not "last night" as claimed in the post.  https://www.instagram.com/reel/DTb1guoiIRj  https://www.euronews.com/2026/01/11/iran-cracks-down-on-protests-and-threatens-us-and-israel-of-retaliation-in-case-of-interve
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — pedantic date-of-footage correction on a tweet about an ongoing protest movement. Sources cited don't actually establish the date mismatch matters; misses the more important AI-footage / authenticity risk.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet's broader claim (Iran protests ongoing despite blackout and crackdown) is well-supported. Note's narrow date-correction is plausible but minor; protests continued through the period.
fact_check.notes: AI-generated Iran-protest videos were circulating in Jan 2026 — that's the more important risk; date pedantry on real footage isn't.

importance.lens_rationale: Iran protests/massacre is high-stakes geopolitical event with hundreds dead; getting note-writing right here matters.
